chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Yunus ibn Yaqoub, who said:
I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), 'Can we drink while we are in the Tawaaf?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Yes'.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to drink water while performing Tawaaf?
ai.summary: In this concise narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) confirms that drinking water during Tawaaf is permissible, addressing the practical needs of pilgrims who may require hydration while performing the ritual. This ruling highlights the flexibility within Shia jurisprudence, allowing for the maintenance of physical well-being without breaking the continuity of the circumambulation, provided the act does not involve excessive distraction or impurity.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Yunus Bin Yaqoub who said,
‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘Can we drink (water) and we are in the Tawaaf?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes’.
en.sarwar: 15. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from Yunus ibn Ya’qub who has said the following: “
I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, if we can drink when performing Tawaf. He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, you can do so.”’
